title: One corner language for the table
notes: Every border-radius in the web client is a surfaces.css token: the corner scale is retuned to 2, 4, 6 and 10 px (xl dropped), the settings switch keeps its track's pill as --radius-switch, and the card faces' cuts and the effects' shapes are named tokens that keep their values.

player.title: One corner language for the table
changes: Menus, panels, buttons, badges and the card inspector have tighter corners; card faces keep the corner their frame is cut to.
